device_transmitter.title: Learn Easywave Transmitter
device_transmitter.description: Press any button on the Easywave transmitter. Waiting for telegram...

device_transmitter_config.title: Operating Mode
device_transmitter_config.description: Which operating mode would you like to use?

menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_1button: Each button on a transmitter can trigger a function. Each button of a channel is assigned a separate object or state.
menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_2button: Two adjacent buttons of a channel are assigned a function (ON/OFF or UP/DOWN). A separate object is created for each function.
menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_3button: All 3 or 4 buttons of a channel are automatically assigned to a single object in '3-button operation' mode. This object has 3 states: UP/STOP/DOWN.

device_transmitter_grouping.title: Control Mode
device_transmitter_grouping.description: Should the buttons be created as individual entities or grouped as states in one entity?

menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_grouping_single: A separate object is created for each button of the selected channel. Each object represents one of the up to 4 available button codes (A,B,C,D).
menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_grouping_group: One object is created for all buttons of the selected channel. Each of the up to 4 available button codes (A,B,C,D) represents a state of this object.

device_transmitter_switch_mode.title: Behavior
device_transmitter_switch_mode.description: Should the switch state be reset after activation or remain permanent?

menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_switch_impulse: The switch state of an object is reset 1 second after releasing the respective transmitter button.
menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_switch_permanent: The switch state of individual objects toggles with each press of the respective transmitter button.

device_transmitter_button_count.title: Button Count
device_transmitter_button_count.description: Please specify the number of available buttons.

menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_buttons_1: The transmitter/channel has only 1 button with any button code.
menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_buttons_2: The transmitter/channel has 2 buttons with button codes A and B.
menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_buttons_3: The transmitter/channel has 3 buttons with button codes A, B and C.
menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_buttons_4: The transmitter/channel has 4 buttons with button codes A, B, C and D.

device_transmitter_2button_usage.title: States
device_transmitter_2button_usage.description: Which states should the transmitter have in Home Assistant?

device_transmitter_2button_button_count.title: Button Count
device_transmitter_2button_button_count.description: Please specify the number of available buttons.

menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_2button_2: The transmitter/channel has 2 buttons with button codes A and B.
menu_option_descriptions.device_transmitter_2button_4: The transmitter/channel has 4 buttons with button codes A, B, C and D.

device_receiver_type.title: Operating Mode
device_receiver_type.description: Which operating mode would you like to use?

menu_option_descriptions.device_receiver_mode_impulse: A short switching impulse of 1s is triggered.
menu_option_descriptions.device_receiver_mode_on_off: The relay output of the receiver is switched specifically ON or OFF.
menu_option_descriptions.device_receiver_mode_up_down: The relay output of the receiver is switched specifically UP or DOWN.
menu_option_descriptions.device_receiver_mode_up_stop_down: Specific commands for moving or stopping tubular motors are sent.
menu_option_descriptions.device_receiver_mode_heating: The relay output of the receiver is switched specifically ON or OFF. The last state is resent every 4 hours.
menu_option_descriptions.device_receiver_mode_universal: Switching impulses can be triggered for all 4 usable transmit codes.

device_receiver_description.title: Learn Receiver
device_receiver_description.description:
Please put your receiver into programming mode for **{operating_mode}** now.
Press the programming button on the receiver.

For instructions on how to select the correct programming mode, please consult the receiver's operating manual.

Click 'Continue' once the receiver is in the correct programming mode or the LED is flashing in the correct rhythm.

device_receiver_description_heating.title: Learn Receiver
device_receiver_description_heating.description:
Please put your heating control receiver into programming mode **{operating_mode}** now.
Press the programming button on the receiver.

For instructions on how to select the correct programming mode, please consult the receiver's operating manual.

Click 'Continue' once the receiver is in the correct programming mode or the LED is flashing in the correct rhythm.

device_receiver_description_universal.title: Learn Receiver
device_receiver_description_universal.description:
Please put your receiver into programming mode now.
Press the programming button on the receiver.

For instructions on how to select the correct programming mode, please consult the receiver's operating manual.

Click 'Continue' once the receiver is in programming mode or the LED is flashing.

device_receiver_confirm_learning.description: Did the LED on the receiver light up continuously for 4s or was the learning process acknowledged by the receiver? (see operating manual)

device_receiver_verify.title: Learning Successful
device_receiver_verify.description:
The receiver was successfully learned in operating mode **{receiver_type}**!

error.cannot_delete_rx11_with_devices:
The RX11 USB Transceiver cannot be deleted while devices are still configured.

Please delete all devices first via the three-dot menu, or remove the entire integration via the three-dot menu of the integration entry
error.cannot_delete_rx11:
The RX11 USB Transceiver cannot be deleted via the device menu.

To remove the RX11, please delete the entire Easywave integration via the three-dot menu of the integration entry.

notification.rx11_disconnected_message: The RX11 USB Transceiver is not connected. Attempting automatic reconnection...
notification.rx11_reconnected_message: The RX11 USB Transceiver is connected again. All devices are available.
notification.ewneo_unreachable_message:
**{device_name}** is not responding.

The command could not be executed. Possible causes:
• Device is turned off
• Device is too far from gateway
• Radio interference

The device remains controllable. This message will be automatically removed upon successful communication.
